verifications.claim: In 2026, Ramadan is expected to end on the evening of Thursday, March 19, or Friday, March 20, depending on the sighting of the crescent moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'next waxing crescent moon is expected to appear... on Thursday, March 19... first day of Eid likely falling on Friday, March 20'; R1: 'ends Around 18 March... Eid-al-Fitr 2026 might fall on or near 19 March, depending on moonsighting'; R5: 'end on March 19, 2026 (again, depending on the lunar cycle)'; R6: 'expected to begin on the evening of March 19 or March 20, 2026, depending on the sighting'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly support the expected end dates around March 19-20 depending on moon sighting, with R2 specifying Thursday 19/Friday 20.

verifications.claim: The final day of fasting will be followed by the festival of Eid al-Fitr.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Eid al-Fitr... follows the month of Ramadan'; R2: 'Ramadan... ends with the festival of Eid al-Fitr'; R5: 'Eid al-Fitr marks the end of Ramadan with a festival'; R4: 'marks the end of... fasting (sawm) during Ramadan'; R3/R6 similar.
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm Eid al-Fitr immediately follows the end of Ramadan fasting.

verifications.claim: Eid al-Fitr marks the start of the Islamic month of Shawwal.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Eid al-Fitr comes at the start of the Islamic month of Shawwal'; R3: 'Shawwal, the Islamic month that follows Ramadan... first day of Shawwal brings Eid al-Fitr'; R4: 'falls on the first day of Shawwal, the tenth month'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in sources confirm Eid al-Fitr starts Shawwal.

verifications.claim: Most estimations suggest the last day of fasting will be Thursday, March 19, 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Ramadan is predicted to end on March 19, 2026'; R2: implies last fast before March 20 (Thursday 19 crescent); R1: 'Around 18 March'
verifications.reasoning: Sources support March 19 as a predicted last fast day (with Thursday from R2), but none explicitly state 'most estimations'; dates vary slightly across sources.

verifications.claim: The Eid al-Fitr celebration is likely to begin on March 20, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'first day of Eid likely falling on Friday, March 20'; R4: '2026 date 20 March – 22 March'
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states likely March 20; R4 lists 20 March as start.

verifications.claim: Some regions may start Eid al-Fitr on March 19 depending on local moon sightings.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'might fall on or near 19 March, depending on moonsighting'; R2: 'could start the next day' (implying variation); R3: 'night of March 18 or March 19'; R6: 'evening of March 19 or March 20'
verifications.reasoning: Sources note variation by moon sighting, supporting possibility of March 19 start in some cases/regions.

verifications.claim: The exact end date is confirmed by the sighting of the new moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'depending on moonsighting'; R2: 'determined by the sighting of the waxing crescent moon'; R3: 'sighting of a crescent moon prompts...'; R5: 'depending on the lunar cycle'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources emphasize moon sighting confirms exact end/start of Ramadan/Eid.

verifications.claim: The new moon concludes the 29 or 30-day lunar month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'How long is Ramadan 2026? 29 or 30 days, depending on moonsighting'; R4: 'If the moon is not observed immediately after the 29th day... celebrated the following day'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for 29/30 days ended by moon sighting.

verifications.claim: Ramadan is predicted to start around February 18, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'expected to begin on February 18, 2026 (following confirmation of the crescent moon on February 17)'; R3/R6: 'began on Feb. 18' (in 2026 context)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources predict start Feb 18 or around it (R1 says 17 Feb, close).
